title: OAuth 2.0 overview
text: OAuth 2.0 lets a client obtain an access token from an authorization server. The token grants scoped access to protected resources without ever sharing the user password.

title: Refreshing an access token
text: An access token is short lived. When it expires the client exchanges its refresh token for a new one, so the user session continues without re-authenticating.

title: Session expiry and renewal
text: A server session expires after a timeout. Before expiry the client silently renews it using stored credentials, avoiding a logout for the active user.

title: JSON Web Tokens
text: A JWT is a signed credential carrying claims. The signature lets a resource server verify the token without a database lookup on every request.

title: Login and credential handling
text: The login endpoint validates credentials against the user store, then issues a token pair. Storing passwords requires a slow hash, never plaintext.

title: Revoking tokens
text: Revocation invalidates an issued token before its natural expiry. A denylist keyed by token id lets the authorization server reject a compromised credential.

title: BM25 ranking
text: BM25 scores a document by term frequency saturated with k1 and normalized by length with b. It is the workhorse of lexical retrieval.

title: Inverted index
text: An inverted index maps each term to the documents and positions where it occurs, enabling fast boolean and phrase matching.

title: Tokenization and stemming
text: A tokenizer splits text into terms, applies NFKD normalization and optionally removes stop words. A stemmer reduces inflected words to a common root.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid retrieval fuses a lexical ranking with a semantic ranking. Reciprocal rank fusion combines the two orderings without calibrating their scores.

title: Two stage reranking
text: A cheap retriever produces a shortlist; an expensive reranker reorders it. The cascade trades latency for precision at the top of the list.

title: Faceted search
text: Facets count the values of a metadata field across the whole match set, letting an interface filter results by category or tag.

title: Learned sparse retrieval
text: SPLADE expands a document into weighted lexical terms learned by a model, keeping an inverted index while adding semantic reach.

title: Retrieval metrics
text: Precision at k, recall at k and NDCG measure ranking quality against labelled relevance. Without them, tuning is guesswork.

title: PostgreSQL full text search
text: PostgreSQL stores a tsvector for full text search and supports GIN indexes. It can rank with ts_rank or combine with BM25 extensions.

title: Vector search with pgvector
text: The pgvector extension stores embeddings in a column and supports approximate nearest neighbour search with an HNSW index.

title: SQL indexes
text: A B-tree index speeds up equality and range filters. A query planner decides whether an index scan beats a sequential scan.

title: Database replication
text: Replication copies writes from a primary to replicas. Asynchronous replicas may lag, so reads can observe stale rows.

title: Transactions and isolation
text: A transaction groups statements into an atomic unit. Isolation levels trade consistency against concurrency.

text: The forecast calls for scattered showers in the morning and a sunny afternoon, with a light breeze from the west.

title: Slow cooked stew
text: Brown the meat, add onions and stock, then simmer for three hours. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

title: Spring garden chores
text: Prune the roses, spread compost on the beds and water the tulips. Seed the herbs once the frost has passed.

title: Commuting by bicycle
text: Bicycles share the path with pedestrians. Signal before turning and keep a safe distance at rush hour.

title: Backyard astronomy
text: A small telescope reveals the craters of the moon and the rings of Saturn. Dark skies matter more than aperture.

title: Tuning a guitar
text: Tune the lowest string to the reference pitch, then match each successive string by ear or with a tuner before the concert.

title: Exposure basics
text: Aperture, shutter speed and ISO form the exposure triangle. Open the aperture for a shallow depth of field.
